name: Wes (ChiefWes)
summary: Found the rib clip: jump on the bone at the Kuldra checkpoint and swing a sword to clip back into the map. TexasPete and Nanobit both use and credit it. He set an early 9:37/9:43 "WR". Thelastiger re-uploaded his run with a claimed co-ownership.

insights.text: wow. first im a big nerd and this is awesome, im the one who found out how to get back in the map from that bone by swinging sword. i think its so cool you used that strat! very good run! cant wait to see future times! im a fan!

video.title: (7:40) Kuldra RAID Speedrun // RS Dragonwilds Patch 1.0.0.6+

insights.text: i was the one who found the strat to jump on the bone and punch up to get back out into the map, i think its so awesome that the strat is being used for competitive runs, this is such a great run. my record was 9:38 and it been smashed a couple times sense then. i think this will be the run that stays at 1st  for a while, great run!

@Nimblesk1 I genuinely think it’s so cool that these strats are being used for competitive runs. Some of these are completely unique to my run only so it’s pretty cool seeing yall run and perfect them!

video.title: Legacy World Record (9:37 ChiefWes) - Scorned Wilderness & Kuldra Speedrun | RS: Dragonwilds 1.0.0.6

insights.text: Wes, a veteran RuneScape player since 2003, set a world record speedrun of 9:37 for the Dragonwilds Scorned Wilderness Raid using a unique map-reset skip he discovered. He coordinated with this channel to have this run uploaded for maximum reach. Wes is excited to gain exposure and plans to continue pushing records for future raids.
